theme.label: Theme
locale.label: Language
empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: Create a project in the sidebar, or start an unfiled chat in Inbox.
settings.title: Appearance and keys
settings.hint: Theme and language live in the local database. API keys go to Credential Manager, never SQLite.
workspace.importedInboxHint: Chats brought from ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
workspace.noConversationsImported: No imported chats here. Open Import Hub to bring an export.
workspace.projectInstructionsHint: Always included in the compiled packet.
workspace.deleteProjectConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Chats move to Inbox. The message tree stays.
workspace.noConversations: No conversations in this project. {{modifier}}+N starts one.
workspace.noConversationsInbox: Inbox is empty. {{modifier}}+N starts an unfiled chat.
workspace.noMessages: No messages yet. Type below and press Enter to send.
workspace.packet.title: Portable context packet
workspace.packet.none: No packets in this project yet.
workspace.packet.needPreview: Open a conversation with a key to preview the packet.
workspace.packet.applied: This chat sends the applied packet plus new turns.
workspace.packet.appliedNotice: This chat now uses the imported packet.
workspace.packet.cleared: This chat compiles from the local tree again.
mentions.tokenOver: Mentions exceed the {{cap}} token cap. Oldest extra context will be dropped.
mentions.error.unavailable: That mention type is not available yet.
mentions.error.notFound: That mention could not be resolved in this project.
mentions.error.limit: You can mention up to 8 items per send.
workspace.overflow: This thread is over the {{window}} token window (~{{estimate}} estimated). Compact drops oldest turns from the next packet; the tree stays.
workspace.compact.on: Next send will drop oldest turns to fit the window.
workspace.modelSwitch: Next reply uses {{model}}. History is compiled — you do not need to paste a summary.
workspace.error.generic: That action could not be completed. Try again.
workspace.error.cap: Spend cap reached ({{scope}}). This send was not started.
workspace.error.unknownModel: That model is not in the local catalog for this provider.
files.tokenWarning: These files add ~{{n}} tokens before the message is sent.
files.error.vision: This model cannot read images. Pick one marked Vision or remove the image.
files.error.tooLarge: That file is over the 8 MB limit.
files.error.unsupported: That file type is not supported.
files.error.projectMismatch: That file belongs to another project.
files.error.limit: You can attach up to 8 files per send.
workspace.error.timeout: The provider timed out. Retry or try another model.
workspace.error.rate_limit: The provider is rate-limiting this key. Wait and retry.
workspace.error.auth: The provider rejected this key. Check it in Settings.
workspace.error.context_overflow: This thread exceeds the model window. Turn on Compact history and send again.
workspace.error.quota: The provider reports no remaining credit on this key.
workspace.error.network: The network is unreachable. Check the connection and retry.
workspace.error.unknown: The provider returned an unexpected error.
workspace.noKey: Save a provider key in Settings first.
workspace.composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to stop
workspace.composer.secretWarning: This looks like an API key. Do not send secrets to a model.
workspace.receipt.title: Receipt
workspace.estimate.none: No catalog price for a pre-send estimate
workspace.cap.warn: Spend is at 80% of the {{scope}} cap.
workspace.cap.block: Spend cap would block this send ({{scope}}).
caps.title: Spend caps
caps.hint: Hard-stops in USD. Empty means unlimited. 80% warns; 100% blocks until you allow once.
debug.title: Debug / observability
debug.hint: Last request metadata only. No Authorization headers, keys, or conversation body.
debug.empty: No request has been compiled yet this session.
fallback.title: Try another provider?
fallback.body: {{failed}} failed ({{code}}). {{suggested}} looks healthier. Confirm to regenerate on that key — this is not automatic.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.send: Send a message or run a slash command
shortcuts.stop: Stop the stream or close a dialog
slash.clear.description: Open a clean conversation without deleting this one
slash.compact.description: Toggle compaction for the next send
workspace.tree.title: Tree
workspace.tree.hint: Jump to a node. The other branch stays.
secrets.title: Provider keys
secrets.hint: The full key crosses IPC only on this save, then leaves the screen. After that you only see a mask.
secrets.error.save: Could not save the key. Check the value and try again.
about.title: About
about.body: AI Hub Desktop — the control layer between you and AI providers. BYOK, local-first.
onboarding.title: Get to your first answer
onboarding.hint: Language, one provider, a connection test — then ask. No cloud account.
onboarding.providerHint: OpenRouter is recommended. Native providers sit beside it. The key stays in Credential Manager.
privacy.title: Crash reports
privacy.hint: Off by default. Opt-in writes local Crashpad dumps with no upload. Annotations are only app version and platform — dump files can still contain process memory.
privacy.crashDetail: Turning this off takes effect the next time the app starts if dumps were already enabled this session.
updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: Checks GitHub Releases. A missing feed must not break the app.
updates.status.unavailable: Update feed unavailable — the app keeps running
import.title: Import Hub
import.hint: Bring official ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini exports. Re-importing the same chat is skipped. Binary files stay out.
import.geminiLimits: Gemini Takeout is an activity log, not a full archive. Use JSON (not HTML). Threads are grouped by chat URL; images are skipped. Some turns may be missing.
import.report.title: Import report
import.report.error.empty: A conversation had no messages and was skipped.
import.report.error.failed: A conversation could not be saved.
import.error.generic: The import could not be completed.
import.error.invalid_json: That file is not valid JSON.
import.error.unrecognized: No conversations were recognized in that file.
import.error.gemini_html: HTML Takeout is not supported. Export Gemini Apps activity as JSON.
import.error.empty: No conversations were found in that export.
